name: Case law: Poland, the Krajowa Izba Odwoławcza (National Appeal Chamber)
label: Poland case law (the Krajowa Izba Odwoławcza (National Appeal Chamber))
coverage: 49127 decisions with text, one file and one commit each, dated the day given: 22168 from SAOS (to 2018-09-06) and 26959 from the UZP portal orzeczenia.uzp.gov.pl (2018-06-01 to 2026-10-12); 19799 citations of law linked to poland-law.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. In-force is the day given. Decisions with no usable date are in decisions/undated/. To 2018-09-06 the decisions are SAOS's; from 2018-06-01 the ones SAOS lacks are the UZP portal's (orzeczenia.uzp.gov.pl), appended after SAOS's, and the nightly run appends late uploads, so the history is not wholly in In-force order. A decision the portal lists without a readable text is not in the record.

source.publisher: SAOS (saos.org.pl) to 2018-09-06; then the Urząd Zamówień Publicznych portal of KIO decisions
source.licence: Decisions are official documents, not subject to copyright (Art. 4 of the Polish Copyright Act); neither SAOS nor the UZP portal states reuse conditions
